role: Language ontology bootstrap for Co-Being Phase 1.7, implementing TAUGHT_PROCEDURE bootstrap across six dependency-ordered layers of linguistic knowledge.
detail: Implements six-layer language bootstrap: Layer 0 creates 10 SCHEMA-level ConceptPrimitive nodes (word, morpheme, phoneme, clause, noun, verb, adjective, adverb, preposition, sentence). Layer 1 creates 8 core WordSenseNode and 8 WordFormNode INSTANCE nodes with INSTANCE_OF_WORD edges (cat, dog, run, big, the, a, is, what). Layer 2 creates ~287 WordFormNode pairs from IRREGULAR_FORMS with TRANSFORMS_TO edges for irregular morphology (is_regular=False). Layer 3 defines 6 ProceduralTemplate nodes for regular morphology (proc:pluralize, proc:past_tense, proc:present_participle, proc:comparative, proc:superlative, proc:third_person) each with full AST body via MorphologyExecutor. Layer 4 defines 5 syntactic parse templates (proc:parse_transitive, parse_intransitive, parse_copular, parse_question_what, parse_question_math) with domain=syntax and step_types: match_root, match_edge, match_optional, extract_role, match_property. Layer 5 creates single proc:disambiguate placeholder for lexical-chain WSD. All nodes use TAUGHT_PROCEDURE provenance (confidence=1.0). Three idempotent migrations fix parse_question_what nsubj step (match_optional→match_edge), parse_intransitive root pos_filter (add VERB), parse_transitive dobj filter (obj→dobj). Main function bootstrap_language_ontology() calls all layers in sequence and returns LanguageBootstrapResult with creation/existing counts.
gotchas: Layer 3 procedures execute via MorphologyExecutor on strings, NOT ProcedureExecutor on ValueNodes. Migration functions are idempotent but log warnings if save fails. No WorkedExample nodes in Layer 5 (disambiguation_engine has no children). Layer 4 syntactic templates require domain='syntax' property for SyntacticTemplateMatcher discovery. Three P1.8 bug-fix migrations handle nsubj step type change, intransitive pos_filter addition, and transitive dobj label correction.
